page.title: Guides
page.heading: Guides
page.intro: Short guided tours that show you how the app works. Open a guide and press Play to start it.

bingoCard.title: How the bingo game works
bingoCard.description: A short walk through a demo card: what a card is, how to open a cell and how to mark a resolution as complete.

steps.overview: Your New Year's resolutions are spread across a bingo card: complete them to mark their cells, and fill a whole row, column or diagonal to score a bingo!
steps.card: This is your card. It mixes your own resolutions with your team's goals, and the joker in the centre is a free cell.
steps.cell: Each cell holds one resolution. Tap this cell to open its details.
steps.detail: The details show the resolution, its current state and what you can do with it.
steps.complete: Achieved it? Tap Mark Complete to try it.
steps.completed: The cell gets a stamp. Your teammates see it and can ask you for proof.

sandbox.notice: This is a demo. Nothing you do here changes your real data.

cells.cook: Cook a new recipe every month

thread.ask: Nice! Any photo from the race?
thread.reply: Sure, here's my finish line photo.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.description: Where to find the ranking and what its columns mean.

steps.tab: Open a game and pick the Leaderboard tab.
steps.podium: The top three stand on the podium.
steps.completed: Completed: cells marked complete or accomplished.
steps.firstBingo: First Bingo: when they first filled a line. The earliest bingo ranks first.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Follow how each player's completed cells grow over time.

steps.tab: Open a game and pick the Progress tab.
steps.chart: Each line is a player's completed cells over time.
steps.granularity: Tap Month or Day to change the time step.
steps.legend: Tap a name to highlight that player.
steps.highlighted: Highlighted players stand out. Tap their name again to clear.

requestProof.title: Request a proof
requestProof.description: Doubt a teammate's cell? Ask them for proof.

steps.cards: Your card, and a teammate's card.
steps.cell: Ben marked this cell as done. Tap it.
steps.thread: A review thread opens. It has its own guides.
steps.review: The hourglass means the cell is under review.

proofThreadOwner.title: Proof thread: your cell
proofThreadOwner.description: Someone asked proof for your cell. Here is how to answer.

steps.overview: A teammate doubts one of your cells. Show them it's done!
steps.header: Which resolution is under review, and the thread's status.
steps.files: Upload photos, videos or PDFs as proof.

steps.change: You can change your vote while the thread is open.
steps.closes: The thread closes once everyone has voted, or after 2 days.
steps.archive: Closed threads are kept in the game's Threads tab.
